question: A man travels 10 km towards the west and turns left and travels 4 km and then travels another 4 km towards the east. He then turns to his right and travels 5 kms. Then, he turns to his left and travels 6 kms. In which direction is he from his starting position?
solution:
Given,

A man travels 10 km towards the west and turns left and travels 4 km

And then travels another 4 km towards the east.

He then turns to his right and travels 5 kms.

Then, he turns to his left and travels 6 kms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be5493acb1d1637a4edf786d9eb6952cbb41f8b083bf1342aad68bbbc67df.png] 

From diagram we conclude that he is in **south direction** from his starting position

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
